display.purpose: Hero headlines and section overture text. Italicized spans take Signal Bright.

title.purpose: Card titles, sub-section headers, named-step labels in ribbons.

body.purpose: Long-form paragraphs. Capped at 65-75ch via max-width.

label.purpose: Mono kickers (01 — ingest), data labels, timestamps, IDs.

shadows.name: soft-inset
shadows.purpose: Standard glass pane lift. Top highlight + ambient bottom shadow.

shadows.name: deep-ambient
shadows.purpose: Hero panel, replay scrubber pinned moment, About hero — deepest lift.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Default :focus-visible ring for all interactive elements.

motion.name: ease-out-quint
motion.purpose: Default ease-out for component state transitions (button hover, panel lift, scroll reveals).

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: Hero stream entrance, drift timeline tick reveals — more aggressive ease-out for dramatic moments.

motion.name: ease-in-out-cubic
motion.purpose: Two-way transitions where both ends need a settled feel (modal open/close, accordion).

components.name: Glass Panel

components.html:
01 — INGEST

Live computer vision, kept honest.

Upstream runs the pipeline behind your cameras and tells you the moment a single one stops telling the truth.

narrative.overview:
Three streams of equal weight, meeting. The Upstream brand makes the river metaphor literal — the product is an upstream system in the camera pipeline, and the visual language reinforces that idea instead of decorating around it. Deep creek green, mid-creek teal-green, and streambank mossy gold sit at equal weight across the surface; no single hue dominates. They are joined by a warm reed-cream ink on a near-black riverbed base, with frosted glass providing depth at every interactive layer.

The system rejects four reflex aesthetics common to AI infrastructure marketing: the SaaS-cream startup template, the dark-blue Datadog/Grafana observability cliché, crypto neon-on-black, and the generic 'AI for X' workflow tool with a gradient hero and feature-card grid. Upstream sits in a quieter, earthier, more editorial lane — closer to a long-form magazine feature about industrial systems than a hero-features-CTA stack.

Glass is core, not decorative. Surfaces stack with 22-28px backdrop blur at saturation 140%, sitting against the dark riverbed so the green primaries glow through from behind. Motion is restrained but choreographed at key moments. Kicker numbering carries the editorial rhythm.
keyCharacteristics: Three equal earth-toned primaries on a near-black base; no hero accent.
Frosted glass at depth — 22-28px blur, 140% saturation, stacked over a radial-glow background.
Satoshi Variable for display and body; JetBrains Mono for kickers, eyebrows, IDs, timestamps.
Kicker numbering, generous gutters (clamp(20px, 5vw, 64px)), editorial pacing.
prefers-reduced-motion is honored; nothing critical lives only in animation.

rules.name: The Equal Confluence Rule
rules.body: Deep Creek, River Mid, and Streambank Moss carry equal billing across the system. No one of them is the brand color. If a screen leans on a single green and ignores the other two, redesign the surface so all three appear, even in small doses.

rules.name: The One-Tenth Signal Rule
rules.body: Signal Bright (#5FB869) is allowed only as italicized emphasis in display text or as a state cue. It is never section fill, never button fill, never link color. If it covers more than 10% of the visible viewport, it is misused.

rules.name: The No-Pure-Black Rule
rules.body: #000 is forbidden. The Riverbed base is tinted toward Deep Creek (chroma > 0). The same applies to text: never #FFF. Always Reed Cream.

rules.name: The Italic-as-Accent Rule
rules.body: The only place Signal Bright appears in text is the italic span inside display headlines (.display em, .italic-accent). It is never used as regular text color. The italic is the accent.

rules.name: The Kicker Number Rule
rules.body: Every major section opens with a mono kicker numbered in two-digit form (01 — ingest, 02 — inference, 03 — rules). The numbering is editorial pacing; it counts the story, not the features.

rules.name: The 65ch Body Rule
rules.body: Body prose is capped at 65-75 characters per line. Glass panels with body text inside must enforce this even if the panel itself is wider — pad inward or constrain the prose column.

rules.name: The No-Black-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows are always paired with a 1px inset white highlight at 4-6% opacity. A shadow without a highlight reads as a 2014 drop-shadow card; a shadow with a highlight reads as glass catching light.

rules.name: The Glass-Has-Something-To-Refract Rule
rules.body: Glass panels must sit over a textured surface — the radial creek glow on body, or a deeper panel underneath. Glass on a flat color is wasted blur.

dos: Do treat Deep Creek (#344C2C), River Mid (#4B816C), and Streambank Moss (#81764B) as equal primaries. Every major section should let at least two of the three breathe somewhere on screen.
Do use Signal Bright (#5FB869) for italic emphasis in display headlines (<em> / .italic-accent) and for nothing else.
Do stack glass over a textured surface — the body's radial creek glow, or a Riverbed Panel underneath.
Do open every major section with a mono kicker number (01 — , 02 — ).
Do cap body prose at 65-75ch even when the surrounding glass panel is wider.
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion — scroll-pinned sections must degrade to static layouts.
Do pair every shadow with a 1px inset white highlight at 4-6% opacity.
donts: Don't make one green dominant. The Equal Confluence Rule: no hero color.
Don't use Signal Bright as a button fill, link color, or section background. ≤10% of any viewport, italic emphasis only.
Don't use #000 or #FFF. Riverbed and Reed Cream only.
Don't reach for the SaaS-cream startup template — pastel gradients, friendly blob illustrations, hero-metric template, identical card grids of features.
Don't drift into the dark-blue observability cliché — navy/teal Datadog-Grafana-Splunk lookalike. If the palette starts looking like blue infra, the river is gone.
Don't reach for crypto neon-on-black — cyberpunk gradients, glitch effects, magenta/cyan accents.
Don't generate the generic AI workflow tool — gradient hero, 'AI for X' headline, 'transform your workflow' copy, feature cards stamped from a template.
Don't use glass as decoration. Every glass surface must have a reason — content lives on it, or it sits between two elevations.
Don't add side-stripe borders (border-left > 1px as a colored accent). Use full borders, background tints, or numbered kickers instead.
Don't use gradient text (background-clip: text on a gradient). Single solid color; emphasis via weight or italic accent.
Don't animate CSS layout properties. Use transform / opacity. GSAP and Framer Motion are already wired — use them.
Don't open a modal as a first thought. Inline / progressive disclosure first; modals only when the affordance truly requires it.
Don't write copy with em dashes — commas, colons, semicolons, periods, or parentheses only.
Don't claim accuracy numbers (precision, recall, FP/FN rate) on the site. Without ground-truth labels, we don't have them. Reliability risk, quality signals, status language only.
